title: Heat, quiet, and a little time to yourself.
believe: A sauna is the other half of a healthy backyard. Twenty minutes of real heat, no phone, then a cool-down or a soak in the hot tub. It's for people who want a daily ritual that clears the head, whether that's a cabin set into the basement or a glass-fronted sauna at the end of the garden that you use right through January.
meta: Hekla saunas in Kemptville: traditional and infrared indoor saunas, and Cube, Barrel and Cabin outdoor saunas in thermo-aspen and thermo-spruce. Text Blaine for your price.
moments: Snow on the roof, the glass fogged at the edges, and real heat on your shoulders. Then a roll in the snow or a soak in the tub.
Twenty quiet minutes. No screen, no news. Just warm wood and a clear head.
The whole family on the benches, then out into the cold air laughing.

traditional.name: Traditional
traditional.short: A heater warms a bed of stones and the air around you to a real, enveloping heat. Pour water on the stones for a burst of steam. This is the classic Scandinavian sauna, and it takes about 30 to 45 minutes to heat up.

infrared.name: Infrared
infrared.short: Infrared panels warm your body directly instead of heating the air, so it's comfortable at around 45 to 60°C and ready in minutes. No stones, water or steam to manage. Good for longer, gentler sessions.

models.heater: Harvia 9 kW electric heater, 240V, sold separately
models.head: A true Scandinavian sauna, sized for two.
models.why: The Traditional 160 is the smallest of our indoor traditional saunas, and it gives you the real thing: hot stones, a splash of steam and two bench heights, in a cabin that fits a basement corner or a spare room. The knot-free thermo-aspen stays cool to the touch and smells wonderful.
perfect: It's mostly one or two of you
You want the classic hot-stones sauna, with steam
You're putting it in a basement, spare room or home gym
You want the smallest footprint in the traditional range
You like the look of warm wood behind glass
models.honest: A traditional sauna needs a 240V circuit for the heater, so plan on an electrician. If you'd rather plug it in and have it ready in minutes, look at the infrared range.

models.why: The Infrared 100 is a one-person cabin that warms you directly with full-spectrum infrared, so it's comfortable at a lower temperature and ready in minutes. It fits a bedroom, an office or a corner of the basement, and it's the easiest way to make a daily sauna habit.

models.honest: Infrared is a gentler heat than a traditional sauna. If you love intense heat and steam, look at the Traditional range. I'll also confirm the outlet it needs in your home before you order.
